source.product: No real product. An invented generic Japandi solid-oak hallway console table created for the hackathon demo catalogue; it does not depict or reproduce any manufacturer's design, and its price is invented demo data.
source.generation: Four-view turnaround reference sheet generated with the codex-image skill (front, three-quarter-front-left, side profile, rear on a seamless white studio backdrop), cut into four images with scripts/turnaround_crop.mjs, then Higgsfield generate_3d model multi_image_to_3d with all four views as role "image": should_texture=true, enable_pbr=true, should_remesh=true, topology=triangle, target_polycount=30000, symmetry_mode=auto, rigging and animation false, plus a texture_prompt describing warm honey-brown solid oak with a fine straight grain and a matte hand-oiled finish.
source.postProcessing: npx @gltf-transform/cli resize --width 1024 --height 1024 (textures only, geometry untouched; 9.71 MB -> 2.63 MB), then scripts/fit_glb.py 110 32 78 to centre the footprint, put the base at y=0 and scale toward the listing size.

knownLimitations: Dimensions are a visual proxy, not a measured product, and this is the loosest fit of the three. Against the intended 110 x 32 x 78 cm the asset measures 103.6 x 38.4 x 76.8 cm: 6.4 cm too narrow, 6.4 cm too deep and 1.2 cm too short. fit_glb.py hit its 10% anisotropy cap and exited 1, so this model would not pass the 2 cm / 3% tolerance in backend/api/test_furniture_assets.py without a budget entry. The reconstruction made the table squarer in plan than the very narrow console the reference sheet showed.
The oak renders lighter and more golden than the intended #b98b5e, closer to a pale honey oak.

Reconstructed from generated reference images, not from photographs of a real object; the joinery is read from the images, so the apron and stretcher are approximate rather than dimensioned carpentry.

No manual Blender inspection or correction pass has been done. Verified by rendering the GLB in model-viewer from front, rear three-quarter and low angles; the legs, apron and low stretcher are clean and connected, with no holes or floating fragments and no dark underside cap.
